instruction: A candid documentary photograph, wide shot at eye-level, in an indoor studio with a red carpeted floor and white walls. On the right, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing left, watching the woman. In the center, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) is seen from behind, balancing on her left leg and lifting her right leg sideways towards him. The scene is lit by overhead lights, with dark partitions and a white column in the background.
